g.text: Quartiles use LLM-call ordinal, not time.
Top-3 entries are graph work types.
Unknown result classes leave error denominator.
Return size is UTF-8 bytes, not tokens.
Error rate 0% does not imply answer correctness.

g.text: Valid empty rows are not failures. Activity is a rule-based proxy, not inferred intent; all graph queries are read-only.
